name: Improve Work Layer
description: Evidence-driven improvement of process coverage, hierarchy compliance, and process step quality.

steps.title: Measure process coverage
steps.description: Query recent missions. Calculate follow_process vs checkpoint_plan split. Group ad-hoc patterns by type. Identify top 3 candidates for processification (≥3 recurring occurrences).
steps.accept_criteria: Coverage percentage. Top 3 candidates with frequency and representative mission IDs.

steps.title: Create or improve processes
steps.description: Using work-management skill: create new processes from successful mission patterns (process-manage create). Improve existing processes with high step-failure rates (process-manage update). Link to projects (project-manage add-process). Steps must be specific — not vague goals.
steps.accept_criteria: Processes created/updated with specific step instructions and intent_keywords.

steps.title: Validate
steps.description: Send test mission matching new process keywords. Verify cortex selects follow_process. Verify completion. Check envelope count < 20.
steps.accept_criteria: follow_process used. Steps complete. Envelope count reasonable.
